>The question is,

>Can my prey play the same card during combat to accomplish a particular
>action I.E. manuever to close range??

Peace be with you,

Yes, the card play restrictions (one/minion/action) do not apply during
combat.

>Can I play the same card during combat to accomplish two different
>goals I.E. one Flash for a maneuver and another Flash for press??

Yes. Again, the card play restrictions (one/minion/action) do not apply
during combat.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
James R. McClure Jr. <jmcc...@e-mail.kdp-baptist.louisville.edu> wrote:
>>Can my prey play the same card during combat to accomplish a particular
>>action I.E. manuever to close range??

>Yes, the card play restrictions (one/minion/action) do not apply during
>combat.

Well, that's a little misleading. The normal restrictions do not apply
to combat cards, but they would apply to any action modifiers and
reactions played during combat (Ritual of Bitter Rose, for example).
